one_line: AI research, regulation, hardware, and infrastructure see major moves today.

themes.title: OpenAI claims exact matrix exponent
themes.text: OpenAI released a preprint asserting that the matrix multiplication exponent ω equals 9/4 over every field, providing matching upper and lower bounds for the long‑standing problem.

stories.headline: OpenAI preprint claims matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4

themes.title: Governments intensify AI regulation
themes.text: U.S. officials discussed invoking the Defense Production Act to pressure Nvidia’s board, New York enacted a five‑year ban on AI chatbot toys, India’s MeitY signaled final AI regulation papers, and 42 state attorneys general seek to block Character.ai’s data auction.

stories.headline: Pentagon officials discussed using Defense Production Act over Nvidia CEO role
New York governor signs five-year ban on AI chatbot toys
IndiaAI regulation papers in final stages and releasing soon: MeitY
42 state attorneys general challenge Character.ai plan to auction private chats

themes.title: Export controls strain AI hardware market
themes.text: New U.S. export controls forced Nvidia to halt AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian nations, halted billions in data‑center loans tied to Chinese firms, triggered a potential S&P credit downgrade for Nvidia, and spurred investigations into alleged GPU smuggling via Megaspeed.

stories.headline: Nvidia stops shipping AI servers to four Southeast Asian countries
US chip curbs stall billions in data center loans tied to Chinese firms
S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance risks
Nvidia faces ongoing investigations over Megaspeed chip smuggling after CEO’s return

themes.title: AI infrastructure deals gain momentum
themes.text: The FCC authorized SpaceX’s deployment of up to 1 million Starmind AI satellites, Nexent Capital launched a $1 billion fund for AI data‑center and energy projects, BP partnered with Wipro to shift 3,000 finance staff for AI transformation, and Meta and Amazon discussed lifting the block on Muse AI shopping.

stories.headline: US FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1 million Starmind AI satellites
Nexent Capital launches $1 billion fund for AI data‑center and energy infrastructure
BP to transfer 3,000 finance staff to Wipro in AI transformation deal
Meta and Amazon in talks to lift Muse AI shopping block
